summary: The three most important visible problems are: (1) high_kick—the raised leg passes through the front of the dress near the hip/waist, without the skirt clearing it; (2) cross_legged—the crossed lower legs and shoes intersect the skirt across the lap; and (3) jump_tuck—the tucked knees protrude through the skirt/petticoat instead of the fabric gathering around them. Similar skirt/body intersections appear in lie_back_elbows and the seated poses. Disabled cloth physics explains the missing drape, but these visible intersections still need attention. The body generally preserves recognizable joint shapes and limb lengths; no obvious tearing, explosions, or reversed joints warrant a broken rating. Clip judgments cover the displayed samples only: they cannot establish smooth interpolation or exclude pops in the intervening frames.

items.name: sit_chair
items.location: Lap, upper thighs, and front skirt
items.issue: The skirt stays flared around the seated hips while the upper thighs intersect its front surface, an expected limitation of the disabled cloth physics that is visible in both views.

items.name: seiza
items.location: Knees and skirt around the folded legs
items.issue: The skirt and petticoat form a stiff tent around the folded legs, with the knees crowding the underside rather than the fabric settling over them.

items.name: kneel_one
items.location: Raised thigh and front skirt
items.issue: The raised thigh intersects the front skirt panel while the surrounding skirt retains its standing flare, consistent with missing cloth simulation.

items.name: cross_legged
items.location: Lap, crossed shins, and shoes
items.issue: The crossed legs and shoes visibly pass through the dress across the lap while the skirt remains spread beneath and around them, producing an incoherent garment opening.

items.name: deep_lunge
items.location: Forward thigh and skirt front
items.issue: The forward thigh cuts through the skirt front instead of lifting the fabric with it, although the exposed knees and lower legs retain plausible shapes.

items.name: run_l
items.location: Raised thigh, knee, and front hem
items.issue: The raised leg locally intersects the front skirt and petticoat as the hem lifts in a broad rigid shape rather than gathering around the thigh.

items.name: run_r
items.location: Raised thigh and skirt/petticoat edge
items.issue: The raised thigh crowds and locally penetrates the lifted skirt layers, most clearly in the three-quarter view, without an obvious accompanying knee collapse.

items.name: jump_tuck
items.location: Both tucked knees and front skirt layers
items.issue: Both tucked knees visibly protrude through the skirt layers while the dress spreads into a nearly horizontal disk, a substantial collision despite the disabled cloth physics.

items.name: high_kick
items.location: Raised hip, upper thigh, and front dress panel
items.issue: The kicking leg emerges through the dress near the hip/waist while the skirt hangs across its path, creating a conspicuous body-through-garment intersection in both views.

items.name: arms_crossed
items.location: Crossed forearms and sleeves across the chest
items.issue: The inflated sleeves overlap into a continuous bulky mass across the chest with little compression where the forearms cross.

items.name: hand_to_shoulder
items.location: Raised forearm sleeve against the upper chest
items.issue: The bent-arm sleeve retains a rigid inflated shape against the upper chest instead of compressing at the contact.

items.name: reach_up_back
items.location: Raised shoulders and upper sleeve attachments
items.issue: The overhead reach produces slightly pinched shoulder/armpit contours beside the raised sleeve attachments, without a major loss of arm volume.

items.name: hug_self
items.location: Sleeves and crossed arms across the chest
items.issue: The sleeves intersect and form a broad angular pouch across the chest instead of compressing into separate folds around the hugging arms.

items.name: lie_back_elbows
items.location: Hips, upper thighs, and front skirt
items.issue: The forward-projecting thighs pass through the front of the dress while the skirt remains flared around the pelvis, particularly clearly in the three-quarter view.

items.name: dance_sway
items.location: Raised shoulder and armpit
items.issue: The raised arm has a slightly narrow, angular shoulder/armpit transition beside the sleeve attachment, but the limb remains coherent.

items.name: dance_heart
items.location: Sleeves beside the crown of the head
items.issue: The deeply bent sleeves remain inflated and bunch into stiff lobes against the head rather than folding naturally around the elbows.

items.name: dance_clap
items.location: Sleeves and wrists immediately below the hands
items.issue: The sleeves crowd together below the clapping hands with little compression, obscuring the separation between the bent forearms.

items.name: run
items.location: Raised knees and skirt/petticoat hem
items.issue: The alternately raised legs locally intersect the skirt layers while the hem moves as a broad stiff flare, with no clear limb-length jump established by the sampled frames.

items.name: sit_stand
items.location: Lap, upper thighs, and skirt during the seated hold
items.issue: The seated thighs visibly intersect the skirt front while the skirt and petticoat retain a stiff flared shape, as expected to some degree without cloth simulation.

items.name: spin
items.location: Skirt and petticoat around the hips
items.issue: The skirt and petticoat spread into a stiff, nearly level disk with little local folding, although the displayed adjacent samples do not establish a discrete pop.

items.name: idol_dance
items.location: Raised thigh and front skirt/petticoat
items.issue: The lifted thigh locally penetrates the front skirt layers as the hem rises into a stiff flare, most visibly at frames 72–74 in the three-quarter view.
